description: Believe what’s in front of you, don’t make excuses for what your eyes can see 🥂 #designyourlife #PersonalGrowth #selfdiscovery
transcript: Believe what's in front of you, and do not make excuses for what your eyes can see. Keeping a bubble of protection around me has allowed me to give permission to my senses, to be vigilant, and to relate information to my internal world. I do not live a chaotic life, I do not live a confusing life, and in turn that prevents the external world from penetrating my internal world.
